-- Do we actually have the sanctuary spell? If it is unlearned there is nothing to -- recast, so the whole swap dance is pointless - it would strip the dps item, fail, -- and put the aura back forever. Matches the prac > 1 convention used by cast_spells. function sancSpellKnown() local entry = Spellups["AS"]["list"][71] if entry == nil then return false end local prac = tonumber(entry["prac"]) if prac == nil or prac <= 1 then return false end return true end
function sancAuraReady() if Spellups["GL"]["autoaura"] ~= "yes" then return false end if tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["auranumber"]) == nil or tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["auranumber"]) == 0 then return false end if not sancSpellKnown() then return false end return true end

-- Nothing else will drive the restore. Waiting on the next char.status means -- standing still out of combat leaves the aura on indefinitely, so book the -- attempt ourselves once the wear has had time to land. Spellups["GL"]["sancretryat"] = os.time() + 2 DoAfterSpecial(2, "sancTryRestore()", sendto.script) end
-- Swap back to the dps float item and recast sanctuary. Only ever called when we -- have a reason to believe the cast can land, because it briefly drops cover. function sancTryRestore() if not sancAuraReady() then return end if Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] ~= "worn" then return end if Spellups["GL"]["sancblocked"] == "yes" then hadarprint("sanc restore held: last attempt was blocked, waiting for a room change","debug") return end if currentState ~= 3 then return end if os.time() < (tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["castholduntil"]) or 0) then hadarprint("sanc restore held: casting is on hold while our state settles","debug") return end if os.time() < (tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["sancretryat"]) or 0) then hadarprint("sanc restore held: backing off after a recent attempt","debug") return end if Spellups["GL"]["disabled"] == "yes" or Spellups["GL"]["SpellsDisabled"] == "yes" then return end if Spellups["AS"]["list"][71] == nil then return end
local floatitem = tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["float"]) if floatitem == nil or floatitem == 0 then hadarprint("sanc restore held: no float item recorded yet","debug") return end
Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] = "restoring" hadarprint("sanc restore: swapping to float item and recasting","debug") SendNoEcho("wear "..floatitem) if Spellups["GL"]["seespells"] == "yes" then Send("cast 'sanctuary'") else SendNoEcho("cast 'sanctuary'") end -- If neither {affon} nor {sfail} comes back, we would sit uncovered forever. DoAfterSpecial(5, "sancRestoreTimeout()", sendto.script) end
-- Safety net for a recast that produced no server response at all. function sancRestoreTimeout() if Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] ~= "restoring" then return end hadarprint("sanc restore got no response, putting the aura back on","script") Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] = "off" sancWearAura() end
-- Sanctuary landed. The float item is already on, so all that is left is stowing -- the aura and clearing the flags. function sancRestoreDone() Spellups["GL"]["sancoff"] = "no" Spellups["GL"]["sancblocked"] = "no" Spellups["GL"]["sancfails"] = 0 if not sancAuraReady() then Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] = "off" return end if Spellups["GL"]["aurastate"] ~= "off" then if tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["aurabag"]) ~= 0 then SendNoEcho("put "..Spellups["GL"]["auranumber"].." -- We only reach here from sancTryRestore, which removes the aura before casting. -- So with no aura on us, "already in sanctuary" can only mean the spell affect is -- genuinely there and our tracking had drifted. The mud is the authority: correct -- the flags to match it and stand down, rather than reaching for the aura and -- failing again two seconds later, forever. if fl == 2 then if Spellups["AF"]["list"][71] == nil then -- Real remaining duration is unknown; {affoff} 71 will clear this normally. -- Transient: mana, moves, concentration, position. Retry shortly, and on the -- next state change. The delay keeps us from thrashing the float slot. -- Back off further on each consecutive failure. Bouncing in and out of combat -- gives us a state-3 window every few seconds, and without escalation that is -- enough to swap the float slot back and forth indefinitely. Spellups["GL"]["sancblocked"] = "no" local fails = (tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["sancfails"]) or 0) + 1 Spellups["GL"]["sancfails"] = fails local wait = 20 * fails if wait > 300 then wait = 300 end hadarprint("sanc recast failed (fl="..fl.."), aura back on, retry in "..wait.."s (attempt "..fails..")","debug") Spellups["GL"]["sancretryat"] = os.time() + wait -- overrides the short delay sancWearAura just set DoAfterSpecial(wait, "sancTryRestore()", sendto.script) end

Unlike the tag it cannot be the aura item coming off, so -- when it does act it is acting on solid information - including mid-restore, where it -- means our recast never landed. function sancSpellDown() -- This message is proof the spell is down, so correct the tracking either way. -- Costs nothing and keeps the flags honest even when the tag beat us to the action. back. -- Skill numbers and recovery groups are resolved from slist at runtime rather than -- hardcoded, so this works on any character without a lookup table. recoverySkills = { {key = "quickstab", skill = "quickstab", label = "Quickstab", class = "Ninja", setting = "quickstab_autocast", pending = "quickstab_pending"}, {key = "stealth", skill = "stealth", label = "Stealth", class = "Ninja", setting = "stealth_autocast", pending = "stealth_pending"}, {key = "stalk", skill = "stalk", label = "Stalk", class = "Ninja", setting = "stalk_autocast", pending = "stalk_pending"}, {key = "shadow", skill = "shadow", label = "Shadow form", resolve = "shadow form", -- no class: usable by anyone with the psi secondary suspendOnVis = true, setting = "shadow_autocast", pending = "shadow_pending"}, {key = "spriteinvis", skill = "invis", cmd = "invis", label = "Sprite invis", race = "Sprite", noPrac = true, fallbackSn = 58, yieldWhenOff = true, suspendOnVis = true, setting = "spriteinvis_autocast", pending = "spriteinvis_pending"}, {key = "desecration", skill = "desecration", cmd = "cast desecration", label = "Desecration", class = "Harmer", setting = "desecration_autocast", pending = "desecration_pending"}, }
-- Seconds to wait for the mud to answer a tracked skill before trying it again. RS_WAIT = 10
function rsFind(key) for _,r in ipairs(recoverySkills) do if r.key == key then return r end end return nil end
-- Resolve the skill number from the name slist reported. Cached once found. -- r.resolve is the slist name when it differs from the command we send (e.g. the -- command is "shadow" but slist calls the skill "shadow form"); otherwise the -- command doubles as the name. Falls back to case-insensitive then prefix matching. function rsSn(r) if r.sn ~= nil then return r.sn end local want = (r.resolve or r.skill):gsub(" ","_") local entry = Spellups["AS"]["namelist"][want] if entry == nil then local lower = string.lower(want) for k,v in pairs(Spellups["AS"]["namelist"]) do if string.lower(k) == lower then entry = v break end end end if entry == nil then -- Last resort: ignore spacing entirely, so "shadow form", "shadow_form" and -- "shadowform" all match. Normalised equality, not prefix, to avoid catching -- unrelated skills like "shadowbolt". local norm = string.lower(want):gsub("[_%s]","") for k,v in pairs(Spellups["AS"]["namelist"]) do if string.lower(k):gsub("[_%s]","") == norm then entry = v break end end end -- Not cached, so a later slist can still supply the real number. if entry == nil then return r.fallbackSn end r.sn = tonumber(entry["skillnum"]) return r.sn end
-- Recovery group this skill shares. -1 is the "no recovery" sentinel from slist. function rsRc(r) local sn = rsSn(r) if sn == nil then return nil end local entry = Spellups["AS"]["list"][sn] if entry == nil then return nil end local rc = tonumber(entry["recovery"]) if rc == nil or rc == -1 then return nil end return rc end
function rsEnabled(r) return Spellups["GL"][r.setting] == "yes" end
function rsSuspended(r) return Spellups["GL"][r.key.."_suspended"] == true end
-- Enabled and not paused by vis. Ownership uses rsEnabled, not this: a paused sprite -- invis must stay owned or the normal path would cast it. function rsActive(r) return rsEnabled(r) and not rsSuspended(r) end
-- The tracker entry that currently owns sn, or nil when the normal path may handle it. function rsOwner(sn) if sn == nil then return nil end for _,r in ipairs(recoverySkills) do if rsSn(r) == sn and (rsEnabled(r) or not r.yieldWhenOff) then return r end end return nil end
-- True if the tracker owns sn. The normal cast path must never cast such a skill: it -- would send the slist type's command, and it would revive a skill switched off. function rsIsSuppressed(sn) return rsOwner(sn) ~= nil end
-- Is sn one of the skills we manage? Such skills must reach the sfail handlers even -- when the mud does not classify them as spellups. function rsIsTracked(sn) for _,r in ipairs(recoverySkills) do if rsSn(r) == sn then return true end end return false end
-- Is this skill known and practiced enough to bother with? function rsUsable(r) local sn = rsSn(r) if sn == nil then return false end if r.noPrac then return true end local entry = Spellups["AS"]["list"][sn] if entry == nil then return false end local prac = tonumber(entry["prac"]) if prac == nil or prac <= 1 then return false end return true end
function rsSend(r) local cmd = r.cmd or r.skill if Spellups["GL"]["seespells"] == "yes" then Send(cmd) else SendNoEcho(cmd) end end
-- The single place a tracked skill is used. Returns true when the command was sent. -- When it cannot go now the skill is left pending, and the state check / recoff / the -- periodic tick try again. healat holds off a second send until the mud has had RS_WAIT -- seconds to answer the first ({affon}, {sfail} or an "already" message). function rsTry(r, why) if not rsActive(r) then Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = false return false end if Spellups["GL"]["disabled"] == "yes" or currentState ~= 3 or os.time() < (tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["castholduntil"]) or 0) or (r.blockedRoom ~= nil and r.blockedRoom == gmcp("room.info.num")) then Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = true return false end if os.time() < (tonumber(r.healat) or 0) then Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = true return false end r.healat = os.time() + RS_WAIT Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = false hadarprint(r.skill.." "..tostring(why)..", using it now","debug") rsSend(r) return true end
-- The mud told us the effect is already up, so tracking was wrong. {affoff} clears it -- again when it really drops. function rsMarkUp(r) if r == nil then return end local sn = rsSn(r) if sn == nil then return end Spellups["QS"][sn] = nil if Spellups["AF"]["list"][sn] == nil then Spellups["AF"]["list"][sn] = 1 Spellups["AF"]["expires"][sn] = nil hadarprint(r.skill.." is already up, correcting our tracking","debug") end Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = false Spellups["GL"][r.key.."_suspended"] = false r.blockedRoom = nil end
-- A setting gated by class or race is switched off when the character does not fit. local function rsGateFail(r, why) Spellups["GL"][r.setting] = "no" Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = false local sn = rsSn(r) if sn ~= nil then Spellups["QS"][sn] = nil end hadarprint(r.label.." auto-recast @RDISABLED@w - "..why,"script") end
function rsClassCheck(r) -- No class means anyone with the skill may use it (e.g. shadow form, available to -- anyone with the psi secondary). rsUsable's prac check is then the only gate. if r.class ~= nil then local ok, subclass = classCheck(r.class) if not ok then rsGateFail(r, "subclass is "..subclass..", not "..classNames(r.class)) return false end end if r.race ~= nil then -- Same leniency as classCheck: no race from GMCP yet means allow. local race = gmcp("char.base.race") if type(race) == "string" and race ~= "" and string.lower(race) ~= string.lower(r.race) then rsGateFail(r, "race is "..race..", not "..r.race) return false end end return true end
-- Called whenever we might be able to act: standing up, a recovery clearing, moving -- rooms, the periodic tick. function rsStateCheckOne(r) if not rsActive(r) then return end if Spellups["GL"]["disabled"] == "yes" then return end if os.time() < (tonumber(Spellups["GL"]["castholduntil"]) or 0) then return end if not rsClassCheck(r) then return end if not rsUsable(r) then return end
local sn = rsSn(r) local rc = rsRc(r)
-- An older version queued these; the tracker no longer uses QS for them. if Spellups["QS"][sn] ~= nil then Spellups["QS"][sn] = nil Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = true end
if hspAffectActive(sn) then Spellups["GL"][r.pending] = false return end if rc ~= nil and hspRecoveryActive(rc) then return end
